name: browser-use
headline: SkillLauncher - Quickly Execute Claude Code Skills
short_description: SkillLauncher is a lightweight macOS application that enables users to quickly search and execute Claude Code Skills with real-time streaming output. It benefits operations teams by streamlining workflows and improving productivity. The tool connects to Claude Code Skills and integrates into macOS workflows.
author: Ceeon

sections.overview:
SkillLauncher is a native macOS application that integrates with Claude Code to streamline skill execution. Press Option+Space from anywhere to search and run your configured Skills with real-time character-by-character streaming output. The tool automatically discovers skills from ~/.claude/skills/ and displays frequently used ones first for efficient workflow integration. Built with Swift and SwiftUI, it requires minimal system resources while providing essential features like smart search filtering, keyboard navigation, and autocomplete. Operations teams and power users benefit from reduced context switching and faster access to Claude Code capabilities.
Quickly execute image processing skills from any application
Run data transformation and analysis skills without switching contexts
Access frequently-used automation scripts via global hotkey
Stream long-running task outputs in real-time from the menu bar
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Ceeon/SkillLauncher`
sections.usage:
```
Act as SkillLauncher. I'm an operations team member using macOS. I need to [TASK] for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use [DATA] to complete this task. Provide a step-by-step guide with clear instructions.
```
